q: Energy demand depends on different socioeconomic factors such as population, urbanization, industrialization, net capital income and _____.
e: Energy demand depends on different socioeconomic factors such as population, urbanization, industrialization, net capital income and development of technologies. Energy demand is the energy people actually consume, shaped by population, industry and technology. depletion of resources or climate change is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The energy crisis is a situation in which a nation suffers from a disruption of energy supplies connected by increasing energy prices that threaten _____.
e: The energy crisis is a situation in which a nation suffers from a disruption of energy supplies connected by increasing energy prices that threaten economic and national security. An energy crisis is a disruption of supply that threatens the economy and national security as demand keeps rising. global warming and acid rain or local habitats and forests is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: At present day, the rate of formation of fossil fuels is estimated to be about _____ kW.
e: At present day, the rate of formation of fossil fuels is estimated to be about 4 imes 10⁹ kW. Coal, oil and natural gas are fossil fuels: non-renewable stores that form far slower than we burn them. 10¹⁷ or 3.35 imes 10¹² is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Energy demand forecasting is crucial for ensuring future _____ and environmental security.
e: Energy demand forecasting is crucial for ensuring future economic growth and environmental security. Energy demand is the energy people actually consume, shaped by population, industry and technology. technological expansion or population control is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Today's world consumption of energy is of the order of _____ Btu/year.
e: Today's world consumption of energy is of the order of 10¹⁷ Btu/year. 10¹⁵ or 10¹⁹ is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Because the population and new technology are always expanding, demand for energy is expected to _____ year by year.
e: Because the population and new technology are always expanding, demand for energy is expected to increase year by year. stabilize or decrease is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Using the conversion $1 \text{ Btu} = 1055 \text{ J}$ and $1 \text{ year} = 3.15 \times 10^7 \text{ s}$, $10^{17} \text{ Btu/year}$ is equal to _____ W.
e: Using the conversion 1 Btu = 1055 J and 1 year = 3.15 × 10⁷ s, 10¹⁷ Btu/year is equal to 3.35 × 10¹² W. 4 × 10⁹ or 1.055 × 10²⁰ is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The energy crisis is the concern that the world's demands on the _____ natural resources that are used to power industrial society are diminishing as the demand rises.
e: The energy crisis is the concern that the world's demands on the limited natural resources that are used to power industrial society are diminishing as the demand rises. An energy crisis is a disruption of supply that threatens the economy and national security as demand keeps rising. unlimited or renewable is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Renewable energy has huge potential to provide solution to increase energy crisis and it is the key factor to the future of energy, food and _____ security.
e: Renewable energy has huge potential to provide solution to increase energy crisis and it is the key factor to the future of energy, food and economic security. Renewable, or non-conventional, sources are replenished by natural processes on a human time scale. military or technological is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
